up: Retrieve activity records for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1902 (Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase FKBP1A). Filter for activities with standard type IC50 and a non-null pChEMBL value. Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending, then by assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    tt.target_type AS target_type,
    td.tax_id AS tax_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles,
    md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
    a.standard_type AS standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBBL1902'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND tt.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
ORDER BY
    molecule_chembl_id ASC,
    assay_chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
